target_moa.text: Recombinant human granulocyte growth factor (G-CSF) that binds to G-CSF receptors on myeloid progenitor cells and neutrophils, triggering signaling pathways controlling cell differentiation, proliferation, migration and survival; a long-acting G-CSF analog conjugated to an IgG4 Fc via a PEG linker

citations.quote: Eflapegrastim-xnst is a recombinant human granulocyte growth factor that binds to G-CSF receptors on myeloid progenitor cells and neutrophils, triggering signaling pathways that control cell differentiation, proliferation, migration and survival.

Eflapegrastim-xnst is a granulocyte colony-stimulating factor (G-CSF) produced by covalent coupling of a human G-CSF analog (18.6 kDa) and an Fc fragment of human immunoglobulin G4 (IgG4) (49.8 kDa), both derived from recombinant *E. coli*, via a single 3.4 kDa polyethylene glycol linker.
